papers.title: Efficacy and safety of endoscopic submucosal dissection for lesions originating from the anal canal: a systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.authors: Nasr E, Ismaiel M, Abosheisha M, Prabhu R, Alqasem M, Kandeel M
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Anal canal lesions (ACLs) represent a significant clinical challenge requiring consideration of sphincter function preservation. Endoscopic submucosal dissection (ESD) is a promising minimally invasive technique for en bloc resection, yet its application in the anal canal is technically demanding due to the narrow lumen and somatic innervation. We conducted this meta-analysis to evaluate the efficacy and safety of ESD for ACLs.
METHODS: Following PRISMA guidelines, we searched PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science through February 2026. Eligible studies involved adult patients undergoing ESD for lesions originating in the anal canal. Primary outcomes were en bloc and R0 resection rates. Secondary outcomes included complications and local recurrence. Pooled proportions were calculated using random-effects models.
RESULTS: Four retrospective studies involving 150 patients were included. The pooled en bloc resection rate was 94.1% (95% CI: 89.6%-97.4%). The R0 resection rate was 84.8% (95% CI: 78.7%-90.0%). Safety analysis revealed pooled incidences of anal pain at 18.7% (95% CI: 0.0%-60.0%), delayed bleeding at 6.6% (95% CI: 1.1%-16.1%), and anal stenosis at 1.1% (95% CI: 0.0%-3.7%). The pooled local recurrence rate was 4.7% (95% CI: 0.6%-12.3%). Median follow-up for the studies ranged from 9 to 37 months.
CONCLUSION: In experienced centers, ESD appears to be a feasible and promising organ-preserving approach for anal canal lesions, achieving high en bloc and R0 resection rates with low early recurrence. Comparative and longer-term data would help define its role relative to surgical excision or repeated ablative therapies.

papers.title_zh: 內視鏡黏膜下剝離術治療源自肛管病灶的療效與安全性：系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：肛管病灶（ACLs）是重要的臨床挑戰，治療時須考量括約肌功能的保留。內視鏡黏膜下剝離術（ESD）是一種具有潛力、可達整塊切除的微創技術，但肛管管腔狹窄且具有體神經支配，使其應用在技術上相當困難。我們進行本統合分析，以評估ESD治療肛管病灶的療效與安全性。
方法：依循PRISMA指引，我們搜尋PubMed、Scopus及Web of Science，檢索截至2026年2月的文獻。符合資格的研究納入因源自肛管的病灶而接受ESD的成年患者。主要結果為整塊切除率與R0切除率。次要結果包括併發症與局部復發。使用隨機效應模型計算合併比例。
結果：共納入4篇回溯性研究，包含150名患者。合併整塊切除率為94.1%（95%信賴區間：89.6%–97.4%）。R0切除率為84.8%（95%信賴區間：78.7%–90.0%）。安全性分析顯示，肛門疼痛的合併發生率為18.7%（95%信賴區間：0.0%–60.0%），延遲出血為6.6%（95%信賴區間：1.1%–16.1%），肛門狹窄為1.1%（95%信賴區間：0.0%–3.7%）。合併局部復發率為4.7%（95%信賴區間：0.6%–12.3%）。各研究的追蹤時間中位數介於9至37個月。
結論：在具經驗的中心，ESD似乎是治療肛管病灶可行且具潛力的器官保留方式，可達到高整塊切除率與R0切除率，且早期復發率低。比較性研究及更長期的資料，將有助於釐清其相較於外科切除或反覆消融治療的定位。
papers.score_reason: 肛管病灶的保留器官治療與大腸直腸外科高度相關，值得有ESD轉介需求者閱讀。惟僅整合4篇回溯性研究、150人，摘要未提供比較性結果，尚不足以改變治療定位。

papers.action: 目前不需改變做法；肛管病灶考慮ESD時，先讀全文確認適應症與追加手術需求。

papers.title: Quadratus lumborum versus transversus abdominis plane block for postoperative analgesia in laparoscopic colorectal surgery: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
papers.authors: Moqbel I, Elshabrawi M, Tawadros M, Abdelmeguid A, Shereer F, Ei Hilali A
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Effective pain management after surgery is crucial for recovery following laparoscopic colorectal resection in enhanced recovery after surgery (ERAS) programs. While the transversus abdominis plane (TAP) block is commonly used, it may not fully address visceral pain. The quadratus lumborum (QL) block might provide better coverage for both somatic and visceral pain due to its ability to spread to the thoracolumbar fascia and paravertebral space.
OBJECTIVES: This study aims to compare the clinical outcomes of QL versus TAP blocks in laparoscopic colorectal surgery. The main outcome was total opioid use within 24 h. Secondary outcomes included early pain scores, time until the first rescue analgesic was needed, postoperative nausea and vomiting (PONV), length of stay, surgical complications, and side effects related to the blocks.
METHODS: We conducted a systematic literature search using PubMed, Cochrane CENTRAL, Web of Science Core Collection, and Scopus from database inception to 27 July 2025 for randomized controlled trials (RCTs) comparing QL and TAP blocks. Two reviewers independently screened the studies, extracted data, and assessed quality using the Cochrane Risk of Bias 2 tool. We calculated pooled estimates using a random-effects model and evaluated the reliability of the evidence on the basis of the grading of recommendations, assessment, development, and evaluation (GRADE) framework.
RESULTS: Four RCTs (n = 419) met the inclusion criteria. Compared with the TAP block, the QL block led to lower opioid use within 24 h (MD [mean difference] -8.92 mg morphine equivalents; 95% CI -11.57 to -6.28) and reduced pain scores both at rest MD -0.25 (-0.37 to -0.21) and during movement MD -0.40 [-0.52 to -0.29]. Operative time numerically favored the QL block, but the pooled difference was not statistically significant. The rates of PONV (OR 0.54; 95% CI 0.25-1.19) and dizziness (OR 0.60; 95% CI 0.22-1.63) were not significantly different between the two groups. The evidence was rated high for PONV and operative time, and moderate for opioid consumption, pain at rest, pain during movement, and dizziness, reflecting downgrades for imprecision and, for opioid consumption and pain during movement, substantial-to-high heterogeneity (I2 85% and 93%, respectively).
CONCLUSIONS: In laparoscopic colorectal surgery, the QL block shows better opioid-sparing effects and lower pain scores at rest and during movement than the TAP block. Operative time numerically favored the QL block but did not differ significantly between groups. Importantly, it does not lead to more adverse effects. These findings suggest that the QL block may be a useful opioid-sparing option within ERAS-based perioperative care, although larger multicenter RCTs are needed before routine preference over the TAP block can be firmly recommended.

papers.title_zh: 腰方肌阻斷與腹橫肌平面阻斷用於腹腔鏡大腸直腸手術後止痛：隨機對照試驗的系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：在術後加速康復（ERAS）計畫中，有效的術後疼痛控制對腹腔鏡大腸直腸切除術後恢復至關重要。腹橫肌平面（TAP）阻斷雖然經常使用，但可能無法充分處理內臟疼痛。腰方肌（QL）阻斷因藥物可擴散至胸腰筋膜與椎旁空間，可能對體壁及內臟疼痛提供更好的涵蓋。
目的：本研究旨在比較QL與TAP阻斷用於腹腔鏡大腸直腸手術的臨床結果。主要結果為24小時內鴉片類藥物總使用量。次要結果包括早期疼痛評分、首次需要救援止痛藥的時間、術後噁心嘔吐（PONV）、住院天數、手術併發症，以及阻斷相關副作用。
方法：我們系統性搜尋PubMed、Cochrane CENTRAL、Web of Science Core Collection及Scopus，搜尋期間自各資料庫建置起至2025年7月27日，納入比較QL與TAP阻斷的隨機對照試驗（RCT）。兩位審查者獨立篩選研究、擷取資料，並使用Cochrane偏倚風險評估工具第2版（RoB 2）評估品質。我們以隨機效應模型計算合併估計值，並依據建議分級、評估、發展與評價（GRADE）架構評估證據的可信度。
結果：共有4項RCT（n＝419）符合納入條件。相較於TAP阻斷，QL阻斷降低24小時內鴉片類藥物使用量〔平均差（MD）為−8.92 mg嗎啡當量；95%信賴區間（CI）−11.57至−6.28〕，並降低靜息時疼痛評分〔MD −0.25（−0.37至−0.21）〕及活動時疼痛評分〔MD −0.40（−0.52至−0.29）〕。手術時間在數值上有利於QL阻斷，但合併差異未達統計顯著。兩組的PONV發生率（OR 0.54；95% CI 0.25–1.19）與頭暈發生率（OR 0.60；95% CI 0.22–1.63）均無顯著差異。PONV及手術時間的證據確定性評為高；鴉片類藥物使用量、靜息時疼痛、活動時疼痛及頭暈則評為中等。降級原因包括估計不精確，以及鴉片類藥物使用量與活動時疼痛存在顯著至高度異質性，兩者I²分別為85%及93%。
結論：在腹腔鏡大腸直腸手術中，QL阻斷較TAP阻斷具有更佳的鴉片類藥物節省效果，且靜息與活動時疼痛評分較低。手術時間在數值上有利於QL阻斷，但組間差異未達顯著。重要的是，QL阻斷並未導致更多不良反應。這些結果顯示，QL阻斷可能是ERAS導向圍手術期照護中可用的鴉片類藥物節省選項，但在能夠明確建議常規優先採用QL而非TAP阻斷之前，仍需要更大型的多中心RCT。
papers.score_reason: 整合4項RCT，採雙人獨立審查、RoB 2與GRADE，直接回答ERAS止痛選擇，值得閱讀全文。惟主要結果異質性高，疼痛改善的臨床重要性及安全性仍不足以支持全面取代TAP。

papers.title: Fecal microbiota transplantation for pediatric Clostridioides difficile infection: efficacy, challenges, and the path to next-generation microbiome therapies
papers.authors: Nicholson M, Conrad M, Diaz De Leon S, Strength R, Kelsen J, Kahn S
papers.abstract: Clostridioides difficile infection (CDI) is an increasing cause of morbidity in children, with recurrent disease posing substantial therapeutic challenges. Antibiotic therapy remains the cornerstone of initial management; however, up to 30% of children experience recurrence, and those with underlying comorbidities face recurrence rates as high as 65%. Fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) has demonstrated superior efficacy over antibiotics for recurrent CDI (rCDI) in adults and has emerged as the most effective available intervention for pediatric rCDI. In this review, we synthesize current evidence on FMT efficacy, microbiome changes, and safety in children with CDI. Data from large multicenter cohort studies demonstrate cure rates exceeding 80%, with comparable efficacy observed in high-risk subpopulations, including those with inflammatory bowel disease and immunocompromising conditions. Critical research gaps remain, including the absence of randomized controlled trials and limited long-term safety data in children. Despite demonstrated effectiveness, significant barriers limit FMT accessibility for children. The COVID-19 pandemic has substantially impacted availability, and current regulatory changes have further restricted access. The lack of FDA-approved live biotherapeutic products approved for CDI in children creates additional challenges. We critically examine the emerging pipeline of next-generation microbiome-based therapies and identify the steps required to ensure children with recurrent CDI have access to safe, effective, and approved treatments.

papers.title: Epitranscriptomic RNA modifications in cancer DNA damage response: mechanistic links between RNA fate, genome maintenance, and therapy resistance
papers.authors: Yang X, Wang H, He J, Yang S, Zhao M, Zhao L
papers.abstract: Epitranscriptomic RNA modifications have emerged as a fundamental regulatory layer linking RNA metabolism with genome maintenance, DNA damage response (DDR), and therapeutic resistance during cancer evolution. Throughout tumorigenesis, persistent oncogenic signaling, replication stress, oxidative stress, metabolic reprogramming, chronic inflammation, and anticancer treatments continuously generate DNA lesions that challenge genome integrity. Although the DDR network normally safeguards genomic stability by coordinating DNA damage sensing, checkpoint activation, and repair pathway selection, established cancer cells frequently hijack these protective mechanisms to survive radiotherapy, platinum-based chemotherapy, poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase (PARP) inhibitors, and other genotoxic therapies. Increasing evidence indicates that epitranscriptomic regulation is an integral component of the DDR rather than merely a downstream consequence of DNA damage. RNA modifications dynamically coordinate transcript stability, RNA processing, translation, alternative splicing, R-loop homeostasis, DNA: RNA hybrid dynamics, repair factor recruitment, metabolic adaptation, replication stress tolerance, and cell-cycle checkpoint activation, thereby reshaping cellular responses to genotoxic stress. Importantly, accumulating evidence suggests that RNA modifications rarely function through isolated signaling pathways. Instead, distinct epitranscriptomic marks converge on shared biological processes that collectively determine genome stability, DNA repair capacity, and therapeutic responsiveness. In this Review, we provide a comprehensive overview of how RNA modifications remodel the DDR throughout cancer evolution, with particular emphasis on cancer type-specific mechanisms rather than conventional modification-based classification. We discuss recent advances across multiple malignancies, including lung cancer, breast cancer, ovarian cancer, hepatocellular carcinoma, glioblastoma, bladder cancer, colorectal cancer, pancreatic cancer, osteosarcoma, and other solid tumors. Furthermore, we critically evaluate the current evidence supporting individual regulatory mechanisms, distinguish well-established causal pathways from observations that remain largely correlative or context-dependent, and highlight unresolved controversies that continue to limit clinical translation. Finally, we discuss the major conceptual and technical challenges facing the field and propose future directions for integrating the RNA modification-DDR axis into precision oncology.

papers.title_zh: 癌症 DNA 損傷反應中的表觀轉錄體 RNA 修飾：RNA 命運、基因組維護與治療抗性的機轉連結
papers.abstract_zh: 表觀轉錄體 RNA 修飾已成為一個重要的調控層次，在癌症演化過程中連結 RNA 代謝、基因組維護、DNA 損傷反應（DDR）及治療抗性。在腫瘤生成的整個過程中，持續的致癌訊號、複製壓力、氧化壓力、代謝重編程、慢性發炎及抗癌治療，會不斷造成 DNA 損傷，威脅基因組完整性。雖然 DDR 網絡通常會透過協調 DNA 損傷感知、檢查點活化及修復路徑選擇，來維護基因組穩定性，但已形成的癌細胞經常挪用這些保護機制，以在放射治療、鉑類化學治療、聚（ADP-核糖）聚合酶（PARP）抑制劑及其他基因毒性治療下存活。愈來愈多證據顯示，表觀轉錄體調控是 DDR 不可或缺的一環，而不只是 DNA 損傷的下游結果。RNA 修飾會動態協調轉錄本穩定性、RNA 加工、轉譯、選擇性剪接、R-loop 恆定、DNA：RNA 雜合體動態、修復因子招募、代謝適應、複製壓力耐受性，以及細胞週期檢查點活化，進而重塑細胞對基因毒性壓力的反應。重要的是，累積證據顯示，RNA 修飾很少透過彼此孤立的訊息傳遞路徑發揮作用。相反地，不同的表觀轉錄體標記會匯聚於共同的生物學過程，協同決定基因組穩定性、DNA 修復能力及治療反應性。在本篇綜述中，我們全面概述 RNA 修飾如何在癌症演化過程中重塑 DDR，並特別著重於癌別特異性的機轉，而非依循傳統以修飾種類為基礎的分類方式。我們討論多種惡性腫瘤的近期進展，包括肺癌、乳癌、卵巢癌、肝細胞癌、膠質母細胞瘤、膀胱癌、大腸直腸癌、胰臟癌、骨肉瘤及其他實體腫瘤。此外，我們批判性評估支持個別調控機轉的現有證據，區分已充分確立的因果路徑，以及仍主要屬於相關性或依賴特定情境的觀察結果，並指出持續限制臨床轉譯的未解爭議。最後，我們討論此領域面臨的主要概念與技術挑戰，並提出未來將 RNA 修飾–DDR 軸整合至精準腫瘤學的方向。

papers.title: TICRR orchestrates mitochondrial dynamics and tumor-endothelial crosstalk to drive radioresistance in colorectal cancer
papers.authors: Ma L, Wei Y, Luan Y, Li W, Dai Y, Zhang P
papers.abstract: Radiotherapy resistance remains a major challenge in the clinical management of colorectal cancer (CRC), highlighting the urgent need to identify novel regulators of radiosensitivity. Here, we reveal a multi-layered mechanism whereby TICRR drives CRC radioresistance. TICRR is significantly upregulated in radioresistant CRC tissues and cell lines and is associated with poor patient survival. TICRR knockdown suppresses tumor cell proliferation, impairs DNA damage repair, and enhances radiosensitivity both in vitro and in vivo. Mechanistically, TICRR functions as an RNA-binding protein (RBP) to stabilize the mitochondrial protein C1QBP mRNA, thereby maintaining mitochondrial function and regulating AMP levels, which in turn modulate the AMPK/HIF pathway and VEGFA transcription. TICRR-high tumor cells interact with endothelial cells via the VEGFA-VEGFR1 signaling axis and transfer mitochondria to endothelial cells to enhance angiogenesis, a process disrupted by TICRR downregulation. Collectively, these findings demonstrate that TICRR promotes CRC radioresistance through a multi-layered mechanism involving mitochondrial function and tumor-endothelial cell communication, highlighting TICRR inhibition as a potential strategy for radiosensitization.

papers.title: RMI2 depletion recovers cGAS-STING signaling to enhance immunotherapy in colorectal cancer
papers.authors: Cai R, Huang E, Liu Y, Lyu X, Fu Y, Bai F
papers.abstract: Microsatellite-stable (MSS) colorectal cancers (CRCs) are largely refractory to immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) due to immunologically "cold" tumor microenvironments (TMEs) characterized by limited T-cell infiltration. While RecQ-mediated genome instability 2 (RMI2) is known for regulating DNA repair, its role in anti-tumor immunity remains unclear. Here, we demonstrate that RMI2 deficiency impairs homologous recombination repair, causing cytosolic DNA accumulation, cGAS-STING pathway activation, and type I interferon signaling that boosts anti-tumor immunity. Notably, RMI2 knockout in mice synergizes with PD-1 blockade and fluorouracil to induce robust tumor regression and prolonged survival. Our data reveal that RMI2 loss derepresses the cGAS-STING pathway by disrupting DNA repair homeostasis, thereby reversing immune evasion. This paradigm shift converts MSS CRCs into "hot" tumors and renders them responsive to ICI therapy, establishing RMI2 inhibition as a novel therapeutic avenue.

papers.title: Optimizing cold resection for colorectal polyps: insights from diminutive to large polyps
papers.authors: Shang H, Zhang R, Song W, Wang J, Wang J
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE: The purpose of this study was to review the clinical application of cold resection for colorectal polyps and determine its efficacy and safety for polyps of different sizes.
METHODS: A narrative review was conducted to analyze and compare key indicators, including complete resection rate (CRR), bleeding rate, perforation rate, and recurrence rate, for polyps of different sizes undergoing cold versus hot resection.
RESULTS: The CRR of cold snare polypectomy (CSP) for resecting colorectal polyps measuring ≤ 10 mm is comparable to that of hot resection. However, the risk of delayed bleeding and perforation is significantly lower with CSP. With nonpedunculated colorectal polyps measuring 10-19 mm, particularly sessile serrated lesions (SSLs), cold resection (e.g., piecemeal cold snare polypectomy (pCSP)) is a safe and feasible option. For colorectal adenomas, however, the risk of recurrence with cold resection may be slightly higher than with hot resection. For large (≥ 20 mm) sessile serrated lesions (L-SSLs), cold resection offers significant safety advantages; however, the risk of recurrence is higher than with hot resection. Due to the higher risk of recurrence, cold resection is not recommended for removing large (≥ 20 mm) nonpedunculated adenomatous polyps (LNPCPs). Cold resection is particularly suitable for patients taking anticoagulants and those in poor health who cannot tolerate complications.
CONCLUSIONS: Cold resection has become the standard treatment for small polyps due to its excellent safety profile. It is now also used for some larger polyps, particularly SSLs. However, strict adherence to histology guidance is crucial for larger polyps and adenomatous lesions because of the higher rate of postoperative recurrence.

papers.title_zh: 優化大腸直腸息肉的冷切除：從微小到大型息肉的臨床見解
papers.abstract_zh:
目的：本研究旨在回顧冷切除於大腸直腸息肉的臨床應用，並判定其對不同大小息肉的療效與安全性。
方法：進行敘述性綜述，分析並比較不同大小息肉接受冷切除與熱切除的關鍵指標，包括完整切除率（CRR）、出血率、穿孔率及復發率。
結果：對於≤10 mm的大腸直腸息肉，冷圈套息肉切除術（CSP）的CRR與熱切除相當。然而，CSP的延遲性出血及穿孔風險顯著較低。對於10–19 mm的無蒂大腸直腸息肉，尤其是無蒂鋸齒狀病灶（SSL），冷切除，例如分片冷圈套息肉切除術（pCSP），是安全且可行的選擇。然而，對於大腸直腸腺瘤，冷切除的復發風險可能略高於熱切除。對於大型（≥20 mm）無蒂鋸齒狀病灶（L-SSL），冷切除具有顯著的安全性優勢；然而，其復發風險高於熱切除。由於復發風險較高，不建議以冷切除移除大型（≥20 mm）無蒂腺瘤性息肉（LNPCP）。冷切除特別適合正在服用抗凝血藥物，以及健康狀況不佳、無法承受併發症的患者。
結論：冷切除因其優異的安全性，已成為小型息肉的標準治療。目前也應用於部分較大的息肉，尤其是SSL。然而，對於較大的息肉及腺瘤性病灶，由於術後復發率較高，嚴格依循組織學特性指導治療至關重要。

papers.title: Serum MMP-10 levels predict incident inflammatory bowel disease: an observational analysis from the PURE study
papers.authors: Wong E, Reinisch W, Moayyedi P, Rangarajan S, Joseph P, Poirier P
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND AIMS: The incidence of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), including Crohn's disease (CD) and ulcerative colitis (UC), is rising, particularly in middle-income countries. This study aims to identify biomarkers that predict the onset of IBD in a globally recruited population.
METHODS: Data from participants enrolled in the biomarker substudy of the Prospective Urban Rural Epidemiology (PURE) study were analyzed (discovery cohort). The primary outcome of interest was the development of incident IBD. Secondary outcomes were CD and UC. Protein concentration was measured using O-link® immuno-assays. Discovery analyses consisted of logistic regression models to evaluate the relationship between biomarker concentrations and risk of IBD. A separate analysis was conducted to validate biomarkers identified from the discovery cohort. Statistical significance was defined using a Bonferroni-corrected P < 1.6 × 10-5 for all analyses.
RESULTS: A total of 1011 biomarkers were assessed in the discovery cohort across 11 019 participants with n = 91 incident IBD cases. In the discovery analysis, elevated levels of matrix metalloproteinase-10 (MMP-10) were significantly associated with a future diagnosis of IBD (adjusted odds ratio [aOR] per SD: 1.75, 95% confidence interval [CI]: 1.40-2.18, P = 7.6 × 10-7). Results were consistent in direction for development of both UC and CD. In the validation analysis, MMP-10 remained significant for the outcome of IBD (aOR per SD: 2.41 [95% CI: 1.61-4.58], P = 5.2 × 10-6).
CONCLUSIONS: These findings suggest MMP-10 is a relevant biomarker in the general global population for prediction of clinical IBD, and further work should investigate its role in early detection and prevention strategies.
papers.title_zh: 血清MMP-10濃度預測新發炎症性腸道疾病：PURE研究的觀察性分析
papers.abstract_zh:
背景與目的：炎症性腸道疾病（IBD），包括克隆氏症（CD）與潰瘍性結腸炎（UC），其發生率正在上升，尤其是在中等收入國家。本研究旨在全球招募的族群中，找出能預測IBD發病的生物標記。
方法：分析納入前瞻性城鄉流行病學（PURE）研究之生物標記子研究參與者的資料（探索世代）。主要關注的結果為新發IBD；次要結果為CD與UC。蛋白質濃度使用O-link®免疫分析法測量。探索分析使用邏輯斯迴歸模型，評估生物標記濃度與IBD風險之間的關係。另進行一項獨立分析，以驗證探索世代所找出的生物標記。所有分析皆以Bonferroni校正後的P < 1.6 × 10⁻⁵作為統計顯著性標準。
結果：探索世代共納入11,019名參與者，評估1,011種生物標記，其中出現91例新發IBD。在探索分析中，較高的基質金屬蛋白酶-10（MMP-10）濃度與未來被診斷為IBD顯著相關（每增加1個標準差的校正勝算比［aOR］：1.75，95%信賴區間［CI］：1.40–2.18，P = 7.6 × 10⁻⁷）。對於UC與CD的發生，結果方向均一致。在驗證分析中，MMP-10與IBD結果的關聯仍達統計顯著（每增加1個標準差的aOR：2.41［95% CI：1.61–4.58］，P = 5.2 × 10⁻⁶）。
結論：這些發現提示，MMP-10是全球一般族群中可用於預測臨床IBD的相關生物標記，未來應進一步研究其在早期偵測與預防策略中的角色。

papers.title: From molecular mechanisms to clinical practice: advances in the immune microenvironment and translational therapeutics of colorectal cancer liver metastasis
papers.authors: Zhang R, Qu J, Chi H, Li Z, Zhang F
papers.abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) ranks third in global incidence and second in cancer-related mortality, with the liver constituting the most frequent target organ for metastatic dissemination and distant organ involvement representing the predominant cause of death. Approximately 20-25% of patients present with synchronous hepatic metastases at initial diagnosis or within 3-6 months thereafter, whereas an additional 20-50% develop metachronous hepatic recurrence following curative-intent resection of the primary tumor, thereby positioning colorectal cancer liver metastasis (CRLM) among the most formidable challenges in oncology. With progressive advances in biological insight, the conceptual framework of CRLM has evolved from the classical 'seed and soil' hypothesis into an integrative, multi-dimensional paradigm encompassing the epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) of circulating tumor cells (CTCs), immunostromal crosstalk within the tumor microenvironment (TME), the remote regulatory functions of the gut microbiota and its metabolic products, and the contributions of metabolic reprogramming and epigenetic modifications. This review synthesizes recent advances in the molecular pathogenesis of CRLM, including the formation and modulation of the pre-metastatic niche (PMN), the influence of liver-intrinsic immune tolerance on immunotherapeutic responsiveness, the synergistic regulation of core signaling networks, the pathogenic role of the gut microbiota-metabolism-epigenetics axis, and the role of CTCs within the metastatic cascade. From a clinical perspective, we appraise the progress in surgical resection, immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) and their combination strategies, targeted therapies, locoregional interventions, and emerging metabolic-epigenetic therapeutics, with particular emphasis on the clinically challenging disparity in immunotherapy responses between hepatic and pulmonary metastases, a phenomenon largely attributable to organ-specific immune microenvironments. Furthermore, we delineate the limitations of current investigations, noting that much of the mechanistic evidence derives from preclinical models and that organ-specific clinical observations remain predominantly retrospective in nature, and We emphasize that developing precision treatment strategies based on multidimensional molecular profiling and organ-specific therapeutic regimens will constitute a critical research direction for improving the prognosis of patients with CRLM.

papers.title_zh: 從分子機制到臨床實務：大腸直腸癌肝轉移免疫微環境與轉譯治療的進展
papers.abstract_zh: 大腸直腸癌（CRC）的全球發生率排名第三，癌症相關死亡率排名第二；肝臟是最常見的轉移標的器官，而遠端器官侵犯則是主要死因。約20–25%的病人在初次診斷時或其後3–6個月內出現同步性肝轉移，另有20–50%的病人在接受以治癒為目的的原發腫瘤切除後，發生異時性肝臟復發，使大腸直腸癌肝轉移（CRLM）成為腫瘤學中最棘手的挑戰之一。隨著對生物學的理解持續進步，CRLM的概念架構已從經典的「種子與土壤」假說，演變為整合性的多面向典範，涵蓋循環腫瘤細胞（CTCs）的上皮間質轉化（EMT）、腫瘤微環境（TME）內免疫與基質之間的交互作用、腸道微生物群及其代謝產物的遠端調控功能，以及代謝重編程與表觀遺傳修飾的貢獻。本綜述整合CRLM分子致病機轉的近期進展，包括轉移前微環境（PMN）的形成與調控、肝臟固有免疫耐受對免疫治療反應的影響、核心訊息傳遞網絡的協同調控、腸道微生物群—代謝—表觀遺傳軸的致病角色，以及CTCs在轉移級聯過程中的作用。從臨床角度，我們評析手術切除、免疫檢查點抑制劑（ICIs）及其合併策略、標靶治療、局部區域治療，以及新興代謝與表觀遺傳治療的進展，特別著重於肝轉移與肺轉移之間免疫治療反應差異這項臨床難題；此現象主要歸因於器官特異性的免疫微環境。此外，我們闡述目前研究的限制，指出許多機轉證據來自臨床前模型，而器官特異性的臨床觀察仍以回溯性研究為主；我們並強調，依據多面向分子剖析與器官特異性治療方案發展精準治療策略，將是改善CRLM病人預後的重要研究方向。

papers.title: A wearable perspiration biosensor for continuous biomarker monitoring in inflammatory bowel disease: Feasibility, concordance, and exploratory temporal dynamics
papers.authors: Ramasubramanya A, Lin K, Shahub S, McDermott A, Fine Z, Hirten R
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Serum C-reactive protein (CRP) and faecal calprotectin, used to monitor inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) between endoscopies, require intermittent blood or stool sampling. We assessed whether a skin-worn perspiration sensor could measure CRP and calprotectin continuously; TNFα and IL-6 were exploratory analytes.
METHODS: At three US centres, perspiration biomarkers were recorded continuously for 3-30 days in 52 IBD patients (27 ulcerative colitis, 24 Crohn's disease, 1 indeterminate colitis) and 19-32 days in 9 controls, with serum CRP and faecal calprotectin sampled at baseline and study end. Agreement was assessed using correlation and Bland-Altman analysis; ROC-derived cutoffs matched serum CRP 5 mg/L and faecal 250 µg/g. Circadian rhythmicity and ultradian (4-12 h) power were compared among biochemically active IBD (serum CRP > 5 mg/L; n = 15), inactive (n = 37), and controls.
RESULTS: 47 of 52 IBD participants (90.4%) completed the protocol. Across 99 paired observations, perspiration CRP correlated with serum CRP (r = .52-.58); perspiration and faecal calprotectin correlated in ulcerative colitis (r = .59-.62) but not in Crohn's disease. A perspiration CRP cutoff of 1551 pg/mL (serum 5 mg/L) gave 85.7% sensitivity and 89.4% specificity; a calprotectin cutoff of 385 (µg/g)·min (faecal 250 µg/g) gave 92.3% and 67.9%. Negative predictive values were high (95%-97%), positive modest (57%). Circadian MESOR and amplitude of both markers were higher in active than inactive IBD. Ultradian power differed by group for calprotectin (Kruskal-Wallis p = .0005) and CRP (p = .0037)-highest in active disease, lowest in controls-but the active-inactive difference was non-significant after false-discovery-rate correction.
CONCLUSIONS: Perspiration CRP agreed moderately with serum CRP, and perspiration calprotectin with faecal calprotectin in ulcerative colitis only. Their high negative predictive values support the study as a non-invasive adjunct to, not a substitute for, standard-of-care testing. All findings are preliminary, and the temporal-dynamics results are hypothesis-generating, needing confirmation in a larger, prospectively designed, endoscopy-anchored cohort.

papers.title_zh: 以穿戴式汗液生物感測器持續監測發炎性腸道疾病生物標記：可行性、一致性與探索性時間動態
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：血清C反應蛋白（CRP）與糞便鈣衛蛋白用於內視鏡檢查之間的發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）監測，但需要間歇性採集血液或糞便。我們評估皮膚穿戴式汗液感測器能否持續測量CRP與鈣衛蛋白；TNFα與IL-6則為探索性分析物。
方法：在美國三個中心，對52名IBD病人（27名潰瘍性結腸炎、24名克隆氏症、1名未定型結腸炎）連續記錄汗液生物標記3–30天，另對9名對照者記錄19–32天，並於基線與研究結束時採樣測量血清CRP及糞便鈣衛蛋白。以相關分析及Bland–Altman分析評估一致性；透過ROC分析取得對應血清CRP 5 mg/L及糞便鈣衛蛋白250 µg/g的切點。比較生化活動性IBD組（血清CRP >5 mg/L；n=15）、非活動性組（n=37）及對照組的晝夜節律與超日節律（4–12小時）功率。
結果：52名IBD參與者中，47名（90.4%）完成研究流程。在99筆配對觀測中，汗液CRP與血清CRP呈相關（r=0.52–0.58）；汗液與糞便鈣衛蛋白在潰瘍性結腸炎中呈相關（r=0.59–0.62），但在克隆氏症中未呈相關。汗液CRP切點1551 pg/mL（對應血清5 mg/L）的敏感度為85.7%、特異度為89.4%；鈣衛蛋白切點385 (µg/g)·min（對應糞便250 µg/g）的敏感度為92.3%、特異度為67.9%。陰性預測值高（95%–97%），陽性預測值則有限（57%）。活動性IBD組兩種標記的晝夜節律MESOR（節律校正平均值）與振幅均高於非活動性組。鈣衛蛋白（Kruskal–Wallis p=0.0005）與CRP（p=0.0037）的超日節律功率存在組間差異，活動性疾病組最高、對照組最低；但經偽發現率校正後，活動性與非活動性組間的差異未達統計顯著。
結論：汗液CRP與血清CRP呈中度一致性，而汗液與糞便鈣衛蛋白的一致性僅見於潰瘍性結腸炎。其高陰性預測值支持將此研究方法作為非侵入性的輔助工具，而非取代標準照護檢測。所有發現均屬初步結果，時間動態結果僅供提出假說，需要在更大型、以前瞻性設計且以內視鏡為參照的世代中確認。
